# proxmox_node_backup_prune (Resource)

Prunes backups of one guest on a storage through `DELETE /nodes/{node}/storage/{storage}/prunebackups` and waits for the worker. Every change replaces the instance, destroy is a no-op.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "proxmox_node_backup_prune" "keep_last" {
  node          = "pve-1"
  storage       = "backup"
  vmid          = 300
  prune_backups = "keep-last=3"
  triggers      = { gen = "1" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) Cluster node. Changes require replacement.
- `prune_backups` (String) Prune policy such as `keep-daily=7,keep-last=3`. Changes require replacement.
- `storage` (String) Backup storage. Changes require replacement.
- `triggers` (Map of String) Values that decide when to prune again.
- `vmid` (Number) Guest VMID whose backups are pruned. Changes require replacement.

### Optional

- `type` (String) Guest type: `qemu` or `lxc`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier in `<node>/<storage>/<vmid>` form.
- `upid` (String) Worker task UPID.
